title: Give the engine array rules
brief: Write unbroadcast, the matrix-product rule, and the ReLU rule, so slopes flow through a layer that multiplies, adds a bias, and bends.
hints: unbroadcast: first sum over leading axes until grad has as many dimensions as shape, then sum with keepdims=True over every axis where shape has size 1 and grad does not.
For out = self @ other: self.grad += out.grad @ other.value.T and other.grad += self.value.T @ out.grad. If a shape does not fit, you transposed the wrong factor.
For relu, the slope passes where the input was positive: self.grad += out.grad * (self.value > 0).
Use += in every rule, so a tensor that feeds two operations collects both slopes.
